en.hubeali: H 14915 – Ali, from his father, from Al-Nowfaly, from Al-Sakuny, who has narrated the following: Abu Abdullahasws, from his forefathersasws having said:
‘The Rasool Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘It is from the nobility of the man that he would have good provisions when he goes out on a journey’.
en.sarwar: 468. Ali, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Abdullah Bin Sinan, who has narrated the following: Abu Abdullah (a.s.) having said:

‘Whenever Ali (a.s.) Bin Al-Husayn (a.s.) used to travel to the Pilgrimage and the Umra, would provide himself (a.s.) with good provisions from the almonds, and the sugar, and the roasted and sweetened stem (beans)’.
